result.summary: The page is largely well structured, but one prominent data-rendering error is visible and some horizontal carousel content appears awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The delivery fee for “Smash Bros Burgers” displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid numeric value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format the delivery-fee value before rendering. Show the correct amount or a fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable” when the value is missing or invalid.

issues.description: The rightmost items in the category row and “Fastest near you” carousel are abruptly cut off at the screen edge, including a partially visible category pill and restaurant card/name.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel edge padding and a deliberate partial-card preview, ensuring text stays within its card and is truncated cleanly with an ellipsis if needed.
